The J-space is the set of activations the workspace can address, and its three structural properties — when it carries workspace content, how much it holds, and how its vectors compose — decide what the whole system can do.

This page's figure is a composite: a diagram on the left, and three property cards on the right built from styled containers — the shape capture returns after its render pass (texts below are verbatim from the live page).
